curriculum.accessible_starts: First 5%: zero-debt starts 1.56-1.60 units from ownership. Next 5%: zero-debt approach at 3 units. Next 5%: balanced near-ownership (4.5), bank ($25 debt), work (easy debt). Next 5%: same balanced cases with 6-unit ownership approach. All have $100 cash. Then intermediate-debt home starts, then full-task home starts. No demonstrations or forced actions.
curriculum.intermediate_starts: 20-50%: medium debt; balanced work/diner/cafe/restaurant/fuel/bank/slots/blackjack service starts plus home. Home probability grows 25%, 50%, 75% in three 10% substages. Food starts have 0.2 satiety; fuel starts have one unit; casinos start at opening. At >=50%, every reset is the full standard home start.
curriculum.intermediate_service_conditions: Food starts have 0.2 satiety, fuel starts have one fuel unit, casino starts use tick 90. All keep $100 cash and intermediate debt; all decisions are sampled from the policy.
curriculum.safe_approach_randomization: Progressively broaden approach angles to the garage and heading error; reject tutorial starting positions within 2.2 of obstacles or map boundaries. Same economic goal and action eligibility, no action labels.
curriculum.radius_distribution: 1.56 + (upper - 1.56) * Uniform(0,1)^2, upper=1.60/3/4.5/6 across four substages; short routes remain represented as the support expands.

reward.financial_progress: U(W_next)-U(W_current), U(W)=0.1*clip(W/2000,-1,1); absolute value of the total discounted signed contribution is bounded by 0.2 (not the sum of absolute increments).
reward.financial_progress_scope: An explicit bounded secondary financial objective, separately ablated; it is not policy-invariant shaping.
reward.base_return_identity: Every finite unsuccessful episode: -0.1 regardless of its duration. Ownership at physical step T: -0.1 + gamma**(T-1)*(1.1+reserve_bonus). The external financial increment is separate.

split_validation: Resolve train.last from count; reject overlap with every reserved bank before any training. Development IDs are excluded from resets, replay, curriculum, and demonstrations.
development_feedback: IDs 1-10 support design and regression checks. Final inference uses untouched test banks.

policy_evaluation.diagnostic: argmax categorical and Gaussian mean, separate deterministic case

entropy_calibration.reason: Calibration revealed saturated braking and a failure-delay reward preference. Before held-out testing, remove that preference, allow adaptive entropy recovery, bound Gaussian means smoothly, reduce critic output initialization, and diversify safe driving-school approaches. This is a bundled engineering revision, not an isolated causal effect.

physics_wait: Free WAIT coasts under zero controls and friction. It cannot freeze position or erase speed. Services require parking.
derived_navigation_cue: Nearest service direction/distance from public resource and contract state. Same information was already present in base features; no casino target. This is an explicit feature-engineering aid, separately ablated in T10.
budget_calibration: Pre-freeze 2M pilots failed to transfer long economic chains. Main budget doubled to 4194304; validation spacing gives about 17 model-selection checkpoints regardless of budget.
initialization_holdout: Main seeds 201-205 are reserved after calibration; no pilot performance is used to select among them. Scenario IDs remain in their independent namespace.

dsac_update_settings.replay: raw observations with same-lane sequence gathering and reset masks
dsac_update_settings.gaussian_mean: 3*tanh(raw_mean/3), shared by PPO and DSAC; Gaussian noise retains full action support

model_preservation: Policy snapshots, selected learner/critics, periodic learners and a full latest resume state; source and protocol copies accompany each run.
result_validation: Every evaluation replays all active logged actions from its exact reset, reproduces saved-policy choices and controls, checks fields and endpoints, and writes audit.json. Only audited evaluations enter reports. Independent intended-rule tests remain separate.
ppo_entropy: Reparameterized current-policy tanh-Gaussian entropy, weighted by current Drive probability, plus exact categorical entropy. Old-action likelihood remains only in the PPO ratio; the old-action negative-loglikelihood score is not used as an entropy gradient.
ppo_encoder: SiLU after each of the two 128-wide trunk layers, then optional GRU and linear heads.
telemetry_schema: Every field must retain time and environment axes. Dealer up-card uses dealer[...,0]; source snapshots of prior calibration retain the historical logging bug.
